shop: I go to the toy shop with my mother.

sign: What does that red sign say?

你能看见大门附近的信号灯吗？

请把杯子放在水槽里洗一洗！

sit: Sit here and read with me!
坐在这儿陪我一起看书吧！

吃午饭时我可以和你坐一起吗？

鸡蛋在热锅里滋滋作响。

skeleton: The dinosaur skeleton is very big.

爷爷把他的旧石板收在盒子里。

你能在石板上画一条鱼吗？

我的雪橇在雪地里滑得飞快。

老狗挨着暖暖的炉火睡着了。

你看见叶子底下的大蜗牛了吗？

splat: 你听见啪叽那一声了吗？
The paint makes a splat on the paper.
颜料在纸上啪叽一声溅开了。
What a big splat of mud!
泥点子溅得好大一片呀！
split: Let's split this big apple in two!
我们把这个大苹果分成两半吧！
The egg splits, and a baby bird comes out.
蛋壳裂开，一只鸟宝宝钻了出来。
Will you split your orange with me?
你的橘子能分我一半吗？
sponge: I clean the table with a sponge.
A sponge drinks a lot of water!
海绵能喝好多好多水呢！
spooky: We read a spooky story in the tent.
我们在帐篷里读了一个吓人的故事。
Is that spooky noise a cat?
那个吓人的声音是猫发出来的吗？
spoon: I need a big spoon for my cereal.
吃麦片我得用一把大勺子。
Where did my little spoon go?
我的小勺子跑哪儿去了？
请拿好这把干净的勺子哦！
sport: Soccer is a fun sport for kids.
对小朋友来说，足球是很好玩的运动。
篮球是一项超酷的运动！
spot: The yellow duck has a spot on its beak.
那只黄鸭子的嘴上有一个小斑点。
Can you spot the little frog in the grass?
你能找到草丛里的小青蛙吗？
Look at the blue spots on this egg!
快看这颗蛋上的蓝色斑点！
spots: How many spots does the ladybug have?
这只瓢虫身上有多少个斑点呀？
The little fish has yellow spots on its body.
小鱼身上有黄色的斑点。
What a lot of spots your dog has!
你家狗狗身上的斑点真多呀！
spotted: The spotted duck swims in the lake.
那只有斑点的鸭子在湖里游泳。
Did you see the spotted dog in the park?
你看见公园里那只斑点狗了吗？
Look at the little spotted fish!
快看那条小小的斑点鱼！
sprain: The girl sprained her leg at the game.
那个女孩在比赛时扭伤了腿。
Don't run, or you will sprain your leg!
别乱跑，不然会扭到腿的哦！
spray: The hose sprays water on the flowers.
Don't spray water at your sister!
What does father spray on the plants?
爸爸往植物上喷的是什么呀？
spread: I spread jam on my bread.
Spread the blanket on the grass, please!
请把毯子铺在草地上吧！
Did the paint spread on the table?
颜料是不是淌到桌子上了？
spring: Do you fly a kite in spring?
The hot spring water is so warm!
sprinkle: I sprinkle water on the little plants.
What did mother sprinkle on the popcorn?
妈妈在爆米花上撒的是什么呀？
Watch the rain sprinkle on the window!
看，雨点沙沙地打在窗户上呢！
sprinkler: We run in the sprinkler in summer.
夏天我们在洒水器下面跑来跑去。
sprout: A little green sprout comes up.
一棵嫩绿的小芽冒了出来。
Did you see the little sprout in the pot?
你看见花盆里的小芽了吗？
My bean has a sprout now!
